scientific_integrity: All formulas are exact; the unrestricted proof is algebraic. Reproduced exact rational and independent numerical finite checks corroborate only. The methods of spectral projector averaging and incidence-graph decomposition are established mathematical ingredients. No priority, authorship or external certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Applies to the unweighted one-step subdivision of complete graphs and the long-time adjacency quantum walk, not arbitrary subdivisions or different Hamiltonians. General design-incidence or association-scheme results may contain equivalent implicit information; literature noncoverage is not conclusively certified.
title: Complete average-mixing spectrum and rank threshold of subdivided complete graphs
